info.title: GraphiScan proposed shared API
info.description: Local foundation includes sessions, onboarding, directory, screening reads and upload/review/assignment/model/request/image handlers. Applied migrations through atomic 013+014 have passed restricted hosted metadata/privilege checks. Private Storage, supported pinned model/evaluation metadata and authenticated hosted/device verification remain required. No production cutover/deployment has occurred.

get.description: Implemented read-only directory. Server verifies current session/onboarding and repeats scope checks in one database statement. School grants permit the school directory; student administrative reads require assignments.manage within school scope. Teachers see currently assigned students, parents linked children, experts context for currently assigned screenings. No screening classifications or images are returned. Missing/inaccessible student details share 404. Lists use descending created_at/ID keysets with signed actor/session/filter/limit-bound cursors valid for 30 minutes; restarting the API invalidates cursors.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Use the returned next_cursor with the same filters and limit; expires after 30 minutes or API restart.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal substring; wildcard characters are literal.

post.description: Implemented transactional directory mutation. SQL repeats current session/onboarding and scoped management/ownership checks. School creation requires a global schools.manage grant; edits require the current expected_revision. Teacher student creation derives teacher_id and requires current school membership; administrative assignments require assignments.manage for source/destination schools, active teacher membership and explicit candidate eligibility. Eligible parent links may be cleared with null. Teachers cannot change schools or assign another teacher. Student creation requires a durable Idempotency-Key; replay reauthorizes and returns current metadata without duplicate insert/audit. Names normalize whitespace; duplicate_name is a scoped warning and does not merge records. JSON is bounded to 8 KiB.

get.description: Implemented minimum actor-specific eligible identities, filtered before timestamp/UUID pagination. Requires current session/onboarding and assignments.manage for the school, or teacher membership. Teachers receive self and explicitly eligible active parents; administrative actors receive only explicitly eligible active teacher/parent/expert candidates, with school membership for teachers/experts. Membership alone grants no school-wide account search. Response data contains only user_id, full_name, role. Signed actor/session/school/limit-bound cursors expire after 30 minutes or API restart. No eligibility is created.
